name: Alexandrie Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted knowledge base and technical documentation wiki with Markdown editing, offline-first PWA, team workspaces, full-text search, diagrams, OIDC/SSO and import/export; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Free software only, not free hosted compute. Requires your own Docker host, MySQL and S3-compatible object storage (for example RustFS), configured secrets, HTTPS, backups and maintenance. External storage, server, domain or identity-provider services may incur costs.
